Agar socho kar sakte ho, toh kar sakte ho.
"Consistency, intensity se jeet ti hai."
Goal se zyada, tum kya bane wo zaruri hai.
Fear ko future decide mat karne do.
Tum jitna sochte ho, usse zyada bahadur ho.
Mind enlightened ho jaye—phir unenlightened nahi hota.
"Mind jo conceive kare aur believe kare, achieve kar sakta."
"Face sunshine ki taraf rakho—shadow piche girengi."
Discipline mind unstoppable banata.
Sahi disha mein chhote steps sabse bade ban sakte hain.
Hamare peeche aur aage jo hai, woh humare andar jo hai usse chhota hai.
